android_manifest_change: only if genuinely required by M4
android_res_xml_carve_out: authorized narrowly for a FileProvider configuration IF genuinely required; not expected to be needed
out_of_scope_mime: audio/*, video/*, application/octet-stream, arbitrary binary, executables, archives
quota_semantics: LOGICAL bytes; duplicates do not bypass quota; a pending upload reservation counts while active and is released on abort/expiry/failed initiation

object_storage.claim: DEVELOPMENT_REFERENCE_DRIVER — not a claim that production Tencent COS exists

content_addressing: SHA-256; the server verifies the uploaded bytes; object identity = account scope + verified hash; the user filename is never a path component
dedupe: same-account binary reuse allowed; independent metadata always created; quota/count/authorization never bypassed; cross-account hash existence never revealed
upload_protocol: initiate -> append(offset) -> status/resume -> complete; no multipart, no cloud-presigned architecture
download: authenticated and parent-note authorized; no anonymous object URL; Android verifies SHA-256 then atomically replaces
quota_concurrency: reserve/check inside ONE atomic persistence boundary; never check-then-race-then-insert
orphans: conservative; findOrphanCandidates()/cleanupEligibleOrphans(); deletable only when unreferenced + no active upload + grace elapsed; no production scheduler
note_usability_invariant: ATT-1 — a pending/offline/failed/resuming upload never blocks note use
transfer_pipeline: one durable attachment_sync pipeline beside the existing note_sync pipeline; never a duplicate upload for the same attachment
mime_validation: signature-based (JPEG FF D8 FF, PNG signature, WebP RIFF....WEBP, PDF %PDF-); mismatch = VALIDATION_ERROR

retry.note: shared with M3; no new infinite loop; AUTH_REQUIRED retains the local file, metadata and pending transfer

network: background prefers UNMETERED; manual retry and user download may use CONNECTED; no FCM, no push provider
security: never trust a filename as a path
never expose a filesystem object path
never store cloud credentials on Android or in the APK
never write a real backend/.env or a real credential
live_postgres: SKIPPED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE (no docker, no podman, no psql on this host)
